entries.title: Analyzing the mixed exponential case
entries.description: interpret $\sigma \neq 0,\ \omega \neq 0$ as simultaneous oscillation with exponential growth or decay.

entries.title: Identifying damped and growing sinusoids
entries.description: use the sign of $\sigma$ to determine whether the oscillation decays or increases in amplitude.

entries.title: Interpreting exponential envelopes
entries.description: understand $\pm e^{\sigma t}$ as amplitude bounds that contain the oscillation.

entries.title: Connecting generalized exponentials to physical systems
entries.description: recognize generalized exponentials as models for damped oscillatory behavior in physical systems.

entries.title: Applying the periodicity test to $e^{j\omega t}$
entries.description: derive the condition under which a pure complex exponential repeats over time.
